description:
In elementary school, Ban Hana was always the tallest in her class.
But while everyone else kept growing… she didn’t.
Now in high school, Hana finds herself face-to-face with a tall, broad-shouldered boy she barely recognizes — so tall she has to crane her neck just to meet his eyes.
And that boy?
It’s Han Gyeol — the same kid who used to be shorter than her.
The height difference hasn’t changed.
It’s still 35 centimeters.
But this time, everything else has.
A story about a 35-centimeter gap — and how their positions completely flipped.
